speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The looms are quiet. A playing day is a good day for a house to be quiet in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are well matched. I am out of it at two, and back when the yard has finished with me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your strap is still long. I am not mending it over a dinner. You have known since Saturday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know. It can stay long. Egeon does not enter on a strap.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can sew it tonight, sir, if you leave the pack where I can find it without a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. A long strap is an honest fault. I will not have it mended in a week when I am only just back in the gear.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat, then. The afternoon can have you at two. I have not asked you for the plot. You may keep it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine tomorrow, on the boards. The king. I have Gaunt's roll in my coat. Today the man has lost his sons. That is enough plot for a dinner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat, and be out of my hall by the hour you named.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The looms can stay quiet while you are out. I will have the hall when you have gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Have it. I am an old man until the jig, and a lodger again after.
